description: Use this when the user wants a swimlane diagram, cross-functional flowchart or process map with roles, teams or systems as lanes, for example "draw our order process as a swimlane" or "make a swimlane PDF of who does what". Takes lanes in order, steps (id, lane, text, kind: step, decision, start or end) and links (from, to, label; branches that leave a decision need labels), plus orientation (horizontal: lanes as rows, flow left to right; vertical: lanes as columns, flow top down), page size and title. Returns counts, each step's lane and flow position, unreachable steps, steps with no path to an end, loops, a geometry check (steps outside their lane, overlapping steps and labels, lines crossing a step), an interactive diagram, and PDF, SVG and CSV downloads. Refuses, with the reason: unknown lanes or step ids, duplicate lanes, ids or links, a link from a step to itself, a missing start or end step, an end step with outgoing links, decisions with fewer than 2 outgoing links or with unlabeled or repeated branch labels. When one step with its branch labels is wider than the page at 6 pt, it returns the SVG and CSV without a PDF and says why. Up to 12 lanes, 150 steps, 300 links. Does not draw plain flowcharts without lanes, BPMN message flows, org charts or sequence diagrams. Download links of large diagrams expire after about 1 hour.

lanes.description: Lane names in display order, 2 to 12, each up to 40 characters, e.g. ["Customer", "Sales", "Warehouse"]. A lane is usually a role, team or system.

links.description: Arrows between step ids, up to 300, e.g. [{"from":"s1","to":"s2"},{"from":"s2","to":"s3","label":"yes"}].

from.description: Id of the step the arrow starts at, e.g. "s2".

label.description: Label up to 40 characters, e.g. "yes". Required on links that leave a decision.

to.description: Id of the step the arrow points to, e.g. "s3".

orientation.description: horizontal (default): lanes are rows and the flow runs left to right. vertical: lanes are columns and the flow runs top down.

page_size.description: PDF page: letter (default), a4 or tabloid (11 x 17 in). Landscape unless portrait needs fewer pages.

id.description: Short unique id used in links, up to 32 characters, e.g. "s1".

kind.description: step (default), decision, start or end, e.g. decision. A decision needs 2 or more labeled outgoing links.

lane.description: Name of the lane (one of lanes) that owns the step, e.g. "Sales".

text.description: Text in the box, up to 120 characters, e.g. "Check credit limit". Defaults to the id.

title.description: Title on the diagram and in file names, up to 80 characters, e.g. "Order to cash".

name: make_swimlane
title: Make swimlane diagram
